summary: # Marvelous Designer Siggraph Asia 2024 Exhibition Review ## Introduction Marvelous Designer is a 3D design software primarily used for creating environments. It is widely utilized in the gaming, VFX, and animation industries. ## Purpose of Attending Siggraph The main reason for our attendance at Siggraph is twofold: 1. To share our newest features from a technical standpoint. 2. To connect with our users directly. We aim to gather as much feedback as possible while simultaneously celebrating the features that users love the most about our software. ## Booth Experience At our booth, we have set up a demo station where attendees can experience our software firsthand. This interactive setup allows users to engage with the tools and capabilities of Marvelous Designer. ## Presentations and Features In addition to the demo station, we are hosting talks where attendees can learn about the latest features we've developed. This is a great opportunity for users to understand the advancements in our software. ## Tying Mouth Challenge We are also excited to introduce the Tying Mouth Challenge. This interactive activity is designed to demonstrate how easy it is for users to learn and use Marvelous Designer software. We believe that hands-on experiences will help users appreciate the intuitive nature of our tools.
